pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/review/page-03.png with Read and looked at it. Tier 1 left: a man in a green shirt with a shoulder bag walks in waving. The receptionist sits at a desk in the foreground on the left. Balloon at top left: 'Good morning! I'd like to see the doctor.' Its tail reaches the man's face. Tier 1 right: the receptionist faces him and gestures. The man's back and his hand holding a phone are at the left edge. Balloon: 'Of course. May I register your details for today's appointment?' Its tail points down to the top of her head. Tier 2, a wide panel: the man leans on the counter, smiling with his eyes closed. Balloon: 'Yes, please.' Its tail reaches his cheek. The receptionist types with no line. Tier 3: the receptionist gestures toward the waiting chairs. Balloon: 'You're all set, Ravi. Please have a seat.' Its tail reaches her head. The man touches his bag strap and turns to go, silent.
pages.observation: The reading order was clear and I did not skip any balloon. All four tails clearly reach the right speaker. In tier 1 right, the balloon fills the top of the panel. Its lower-left edge comes close to the man's head, which is cut off at the left edge, and may overlap his hair slightly. The receptionist's face is clear. No balloon covers the phone, the hands or the monitor. Story point: the registration happens off-panel between 'Yes, please.' and 'You're all set, Ravi.' The man never says his name on the page, so being greeted by name reads as a small jump. It is acceptable if earlier pages introduce him. Prop continuity, not lettering: a phone lies on the counter in tier 1, he holds a phone in tier 1 right, and a phone lies on the counter in front of him in tier 2. It is unclear whether this is the same phone.
